scene: The dial clicks, and three transit gates slide open along the quay.
picture: Flat side view. Along the stone quay, from left to right: a green garden tram draped in ivy; the player pushing his plant bicycle beside the bronze heron; an orange streetcar; and a sleek red bento train. Overhead transit signs point toward the sky nursery, chimney street, and bullet train station.
shown: a vine-covered green tram waiting with doors open on the far left
a vintage orange streetcar parked at the platform in the centre
a sleek red bento express train idling on tracks on the far right
